title: Victorian Big Battery: Victorian Big Battery Delivering Energy Reserves
summary: AEMO reported the 300 MW / 450 MWh Victorian Big Battery fully operational in the System Integrity Protection Scheme. Phase 56E entity use: The sequence supports incident, registration, and declared capability milestones while leaving realized later performance unobserved.
key_findings: The asset could automatically discharge up to 250 MW as an emergency reserve under the scheme.
Entity layer: Victorian Big Battery at Moorabool.
Compatibility boundary: Stable asset; the sequence supports temporal order but not causal proof that one action produced later performance.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: Declared capability and scheme role do not establish realized annual dispatch, availability, revenue, degradation, or avoided outages.
Independent safety regulator and system operator records.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
